# ferriskey_client_role (Resource)

Manages a role owned by a FerrisKey client (a client role). The role is created through the client roles endpoint and then managed through the realm role endpoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_role" "reader" {
  realm       = "acme"
  client_id   = ferriskey_client.app.client_uuid
  name        = "reader"
  description = "Read-only access"

  permissions = ["view_users"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) UUID of the client that owns the role. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Set of permission identifiers granted by the role.
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the client belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Role description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{client_id}/{role_id}`.
- `role_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_client_role.reader acme/1c0e2f3a-1111-2222-3333-444455556666/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
